title: Banana SMP Plushies (Abandoned)
description: Ever wanted to have the members of Banana SMP as marketable plushies? No... TOO BAD!
body:
Banana SMP Plushies is a minecraft mod for the Banana SMP that adds fun, cosmetic plushies of the Banana SMP members

Disclaimer: This project was, and is, not affilliated with the official Banana SMP creative team in any way shape and/or form

IMPORTANT NOTE:
Due to some slight conflict with the server and certian issues, this project is abandoned and will no longer recieve any update of any kind.
If you really want to make addons for this mod, you may use model assets as you like. HOWEVER, you are NOT allowed in any way allowed to use the assets from this mod in your own even if they are unused.
